1CH 8:1.KJV: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
1CH 8:1.BHSA: וּבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן הֹולִ֖יד אֶת־בֶּ֣לַע בְּכֹרֹ֑ו אַשְׁבֵּל֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְאַחְרַ֖ח הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃

1CH 8:2.KJV: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

1CH 8:3.KJV: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
1CH 8:3.BHSA: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בָנִ֖ים לְבָ֑לַע אַדָּ֥ר וְגֵרָ֖א וַאֲבִיהֽוּד׃

1CH 8:4.KJV: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

1CH 8:5.KJV: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

1CH 8:6.KJV: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
1CH 8:6.BHSA: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אֵח֑וּד אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם רָאשֵׁ֤י אָבֹות֙ לְיֹ֣ושְׁבֵי גֶ֔בַע וַיַּגְל֖וּם אֶל־מָנָֽחַת׃

1CH 8:7.KJV: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
1CH 8:7.BHSA: וְנַעֲמָ֧ן וַאֲחִיָּ֛ה וְגֵרָ֖א ה֣וּא הֶגְלָ֑ם וְהֹולִ֥יד אֶת־עֻזָּ֖א וְאֶת־אֲחִיחֻֽד׃

1CH 8:8.KJV: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
1CH 8:8.BHSA: וְשַׁחֲרַ֗יִם הֹולִיד֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מֹואָ֔ב מִן־שִׁלְחֹ֖ו אֹתָ֑ם חוּשִׁ֥ים וְאֶֽת־בַּעֲרָ֖א נָשָֽׁיו׃

1CH 8:9.KJV: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
1CH 8:9.BHSA: וַיֹּ֖ולֶד מִן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ אִשְׁתֹּ֑ו אֶת־יֹובָב֙ וְאֶת־צִבְיָ֔א וְאֶת־מֵישָׁ֖א וְאֶת־מַלְכָּֽם׃

1CH 8:10.KJV: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
1CH 8:10.BHSA: וְאֶת־יְע֥וּץ וְאֶת־שָֽׂכְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִרְמָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָנָ֖יו רָאשֵׁ֥י אָבֹֽות׃

1CH 8:11.KJV: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

1CH 8:12.KJV: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
1CH 8:12.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְפַּ֔עַל עֵ֥בֶר וּמִשְׁעָ֖ם וָשָׁ֑מֶד ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־אֹונֹ֔ו וְאֶת־לֹ֖ד וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

1CH 8:13.KJV: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
1CH 8:13.BHSA: וּבְרִעָ֣ה וָשֶׁ֔מַע הֵ֚מָּה רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָבֹ֔ות לְיֹושְׁבֵ֖י אַיָּלֹ֑ון הֵ֥מָּה הִבְרִ֖יחוּ אֶת־יֹ֥ושְׁבֵי גַֽת׃

1CH 8:15.KJV: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

1CH 8:16.KJV: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

1CH 8:17.KJV: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

1CH 8:18.KJV: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

1CH 8:19.KJV: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

1CH 8:20.KJV: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

1CH 8:21.KJV: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

1CH 8:22.KJV: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

1CH 8:23.KJV: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

1CH 8:24.KJV: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

1CH 8:25.KJV: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

1CH 8:26.KJV: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

1CH 8:27.KJV: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

1CH 8:28.KJV: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
1CH 8:28.BHSA: אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אָבֹ֛ות לְתֹלְדֹותָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ ס

1CH 8:29.KJV: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife's name was Maachah:
1CH 8:29.BHSA: וּבְגִבְעֹ֥ון יָשְׁב֖וּ אֲבִ֣י גִבְעֹ֑ון וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתֹּ֖ו מַעֲכָֽה׃

1CH 8:30.KJV: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
1CH 8:30.BHSA: וּבְנֹ֥ו הַבְּכֹ֖ור עַבְדֹּ֑ון וְצ֥וּר וְקִ֖ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנָדָֽב׃

1CH 8:31.KJV: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

1CH 8:32.KJV: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
1CH 8:32.BHSA: וּמִקְלֹ֖ות הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־שִׁמְאָ֑ה וְאַף־הֵ֗מָּה נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם־אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ ס

1CH 8:33.KJV: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
1CH 8:33.BHSA: וְנֵר֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הֹולִ֤יד אֶת־יְהֹֽונָתָן֙ וְאֶת־מַלְכִּי־שׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־אֲבִֽינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃

1CH 8:34.KJV: And the son of Jonathan was Meribbaal; and Meribbaal begat Micah.
1CH 8:34.BHSA: וּבֶן־יְהֹונָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִ֥יב בַּ֖עַל הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־מִיכָֽה׃ ס

1CH 8:35.KJV: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
1CH 8:35.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּיתֹ֥ון וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַאְרֵ֥עַ וְאָחָֽז׃

1CH 8:36.KJV: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
1CH 8:36.BHSA: וְאָחָז֙ הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־יְהֹועַדָּ֔ה וִיהֹֽועַדָּ֗ה הֹולִ֛יד אֶת־עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הֹולִ֥יד אֶת־מֹוצָֽא׃

1CH 8:37.KJV: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
1CH 8:37.BHSA: וּמֹוצָ֖א הֹולִ֣יד אֶת־בִּנְעָ֑א רָפָ֥ה בְנֹ֛ו אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנֹ֖ו אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 8:38.KJV: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
1CH 8:38.BHSA: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמֹותָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם׀ בֹּ֨כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃

1CH 8:39.KJV: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
1CH 8:39.BHSA: וּבְנֵ֖י עֵ֣שֶׁק אָחִ֑יו אוּלָ֣ם בְּכֹרֹ֔ו יְעוּשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וֶֽאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃

1CH 8:40.KJV: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons' sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
1CH 8:40.BHSA: וַֽיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־א֠וּלָם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים גִּבֹּרֵי־חַ֜יִל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת וּמַרְבִּ֤ים בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים מֵאָ֖ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֑ים כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃ פ
